name: Form of the Pseudodragon
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 7, druid 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a pseudodragon scale)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw see below; Spell Resistance no

EFFECT

You assume the form of a Tiny pseudodragon. You gain +6 size bonus to Dexterity, a +2 natural armor bonus, fly 60 feet (good), darkvision 60 feet, low-light vision, a bite attack (1d2) and a sting attack (1d3 plus poison, Fort save negate).

Sting—injury; save Fort DC 14; frequency 1/minute for 10 minutes; effect sleep for 1 minute; cure 1 save.
